verdict.rationale: Serverless GPU endpoints are a fair axis for a GPU cloud, but the evidence shows only on-demand GPU VM instances, 1-Click Clusters, Managed Kubernetes and Slurm, all of which are provisioned resources billed while running. Nothing documents serverless workers, request-driven autoscaling, or scale-to-zero. Support's statement that Lambda 'does not distinguish between idle and in use instance states' matches an always-on instance model, and an inference-server guide or Kubernetes cluster is at most an adjacent building block.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances
